title: Halloween Weekend Haunted-House Parties in South Florida
igCaption:
Three Halloween stops with DJs and late-night plans.
Oct. 31, South Florida

Sources: WSVN 7News, Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#MiamiHalloween #SouthFloridaEvents #HalloweenWeekend #MiamiNightlife

scenes.text: Which Halloween spots in South Florida also bring DJs and late-night plans this weekend?
Factory Town in Hialeah is staging Halloween with five massive stages, more than 100 artists, and haunted dystopian performances.

scenes.text: Room 901 in Fort Lauderdale turns into a Carrie-inspired 1970s prom from October 8 through Halloween. It sits inside Hyatt Centric Las Olas at 100 E. Las Olas Blvd. with red-and-black décor, candlelight, dramatic florals, and a retro soundtrack. If you’re there, open NEAR and see who else is at prom.

scenes.text: Dom’s in Brickell runs its Trick or Tequila party on October 31. It starts at 5 p.m. with tequila specials, a costume contest, a DJ spinning spooky tunes, and a $150 gift card for the best-dressed guest.
